decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority).

Condition : 4 - REASON FOR APPROVAL 

It is considered that the proposed single-storey side extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 36 Swan Road and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance, the development is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
